description: How tall the BOTTOM sheet of a TmSidePanel is (the phone presentation). The side sheet and the docked panel have no height of their own, so the choice does not apply to them.

members.name: Snap
members.description: The sheet rests on a snap point: SheetSnapPoints (default half height and the cap) at SheetSnapIndex, with a draggable, keyboard-operable handle between the snaps. The default and the pre-2.12 behaviour.

members.name: Content
members.description: The sheet is as tall as its content, under the cap SheetMaxHeight (default 0.85 of the viewport): a short form shows whole without dragging, a longer body scrolls while the footer stays pinned to the bottom. No snaps, so SheetSnapPoints and SheetSnapIndex are ignored and the grabber is a decorative swipe target.
